task.title: Check that the desktop's board preload loads
task.description: desktop/scripts/check-shell.js parses every file and pairs preload.js's channels with main.js, but it never loads src/preload/board.js, and the board view's webPreferences are not checked either. On the keyboard-shortcuts branch, adding a require('./boardcommand') to board.js made the preload fail to load under Electron's default sandbox — taking the board's whole theme handshake (theme:current, board:scheme, board:align) with it — and every check stayed green; only a manual smoke run found it. Add a check that (a) requires board.js's dependencies in a plain Node context to prove they resolve, and (b) asserts the board WebContentsView's webPreferences carry sandbox: false whenever the preload requires a sibling module (or, better, bundles/inlines the preload so the sandbox can stay on). Also consider pairing board.js's ipcRenderer.on channels with main.js's webContents.send calls the way preload.js's are.
